Best candidate so far: `a = c0 + c1·x + c2·x/v + c3·√x + c4·x²`, plus a 1/x term, with c2 ≈ -1.35 consistently. The x/v coefficient is the most stable finding; the √x and 1/x pieces are probably standing in for the true functional form.
